prompt:
You are designing a premium, commercially desirable SaaS product, not a default ERP admin template. FMC is a food manufacturing operations product for spice and masala brands. Create an elegant art-directed product interface with effortless readability. DESIGN AT 1440 CSS PIXELS DESKTOP, viewport about 1050px high. Body text 15px minimum, table data 14px minimum, page heading 32px, KPI numbers 38px. Do not shrink to fit excessive data. Use a refined warm ivory canvas #F7F8F5, white cards, dark pine ink #172E28, muted gray-green secondary text #738078, deep forest accent #24634D and soft sage #EAF1E8. Amber only for attention and red only for real issues. Thin neutral borders, 14px card radii, very subtle shadows, 24-32px padding, 24px section gaps. Typography Manrope or Inter, modern confident medium weights, tabular numbers. Crisp Lucide-style outline icons. Absolutely no gradients, photos, decorative illustrations, neon, glass, tiny uppercase data everywhere, cramped tables, excessive badge soup, thick borders, machine telemetry or fake live status. Visual quality on par with carefully crafted modern paid B2B software. Design for sale to serious business owners.
SHARED SHELL: 216px WHITE sidebar, strong small forest-green FMC monogram and FMC wordmark with quiet Food operations subtitle. Simple nav Overview, Production, Quality with small count12, Receiving, Dispatch, Recall; only one active with sage background and forest text. Sidebar lower area a small static Spice & masala operations descriptor, no invented settings buttons or user profile. 72px topbar with company selector FM Demo Foods, breadcrumb. Main area max-width 1160, 32px horizontal padding. No global search, emergency stop, shift selector, printing, revenue, settings, machines or other unsupported controls. Keep this shell identical across the two screens. All visible copy calm, short and useful. User actions should be obvious; information should breathe.
 MATCH THE APPROVED PROJECT OVERVIEW EXACTLY: project3395685398154969203 screen e7f0eeb2bf864345bf25d11e5f6bb94e. Existing design system reused. Critical no extra header content: only company selector and breadcrumb, optional Refresh. Never add fake live status, telemetry, shift labels or machine controls. Keep an airy premium design, 15px body and 14px table data, hierarchy and readability over cramming everything in. Content can scroll. Desktop 1440 CSSpx with 216px white sidebar. Adapt at390px with menu button, compact company context, single column cards and readable mobile data rows. No horizontal page overflow. Same warm ivory #F7F8F5 / white surfaces / forest #24634D / dark pine #172E28. All controls are conceptual, existing ERPNext workflow only. Recall & Traceability. Active Recall. Header Recall & traceability, subtitle Follow a batch to the customers it reached. Quiet Read only label. Wide search card exact batch ID CHI-014 with keyboard scanner support and primary Trace batch. Clear selected source batch summary Chilli Powder / supplier lotSV-261001 / Quarantine. Actual API returns affected batches and customer deliveries only: DO NOT INVENT a manufacturing genealogy graph or order links. Instead arrange three quiet summary counts1source batch,4affected batches,2deliveries; a very clear affected batches table (batch,item,supplier lot,current status) with CHI-014,GM-BULK-028,GM50-021,GM100-009. Customer deliveries and returns table: DN-0032 Apex Retailers GM50-02124Oct2026 +48packs Dispatch, DN-0033 Metro Stores GM100-00924Oct2026 +24packs Dispatch, DN-RET-0004 Metro Stores GM100-00925Oct2026 -6packs Return. Do not total kg and packs. Link Open Quality for audited Hold decisions, never execute recall. Include an understated but readable amber incomplete-result example notice: Trace limit reached; these results may be incomplete (6levels/200batches). No invented nodes, supplier address, lab data, exports or printing. Mobile search then summaries and cards/tables, comfortable whitespace. Generate the complete polished screen now.
